title: Eric Davis helped write a book for Bigelow during AAWSAP
summary: Jack tells of Eric Davis helped write a book for Bigelow during AAWSAP, about 2008-2010s at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: During OAP, it turns out basically Davis was helping write that book at the time for BB.

plain: A podcast host named Jack, speaking on Jesse Michels's show, talks about AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained phenomena that ran from around 2008 and was run through businessman Robert Bigelow's company. Jack says that during that programme, the physicist Eric Davis was helping write a book for Bigelow. He raises it to show how closely the people in that programme worked together.
